premium.disclosure: Premium subscriptions are processed by RevenueCat and, for purchases made on the web, Stripe. CoutureCast shares your account id and purchase state with these processors so your subscription works everywhere you sign in. Card numbers are handled by the payment provider and never reach CoutureCast.
